data.one_liner: A collection of 30+ animated loading indicator widgets for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a comprehensive set of customizable animated loading indicators for mobile and web applications. Users can adjust sizes, colors, and animation durations.
use_when: You need ready-made animated loading indicators for your Flutter application.
You want to customize colors, sizes, and durations of loading animations easily.
avoid_when: You require complex state-driven loading screens that manage data fetching internally.
You need non-visual utilities or logic packages.
strengths: Over 30 unique loader animations available out of the box.
Highly customizable properties like size, color, and duration.
Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, Web, and desktop.
weaknesses: Limited documentation on advanced customization beyond basic examples.
Early version (0.0.5) which may undergo breaking changes.
